Hero.title: Spectra
Hero.subtitle: Screen sharing for AI.
Hero.tagline: Just say "look at my screen" — and AI sees it.

Features.title: Give AI Eyes on Your Screen
Features.subtitle: No manual screenshots. No copy-pasting. AI sees exactly what you see, in real-time.

gui.title: One Click to Share
gui.description: Select which window or screen to share with AI, just like you would in a video call.

mcp.title: Seamless Integration
mcp.description: Works with MCP-compatible AI tools. Once set up, AI can view your screen anytime you ask.

multiClient.title: Works with Your AI
multiClient.description: Claude, Gemini, Codex — use your favorite AI. Spectra bridges them all to your screen.

native.title: Fast & Native
native.description: Built for macOS with Swift. Instant capture, minimal latency, no lag.

HowItWorks.title: How It Works
HowItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to let AI see your screen.

step1.label: 01. PICK
step1.title: Choose What to Share
step1.description: Select a specific window or your entire screen from the simple interface.

step2.label: 02. ASK
step2.title: Talk to Your AI
step2.description: Ask your AI "look at my screen" or "what's on my screen?" — it just works.

step3.label: 03. DONE
step3.title: AI Sees & Responds
step3.description: Your AI receives the screenshot and understands your context instantly.
